description: This Java class 'DefaultMonitoringConfig' provides access to monitoring configuration values such as logger and counter settings for a connection within the Eclipse Ditto service. It reads configuration data from a Typesafe Config object, scoped under the 'monitoring' path, and implements the MonitoringConfig interface.

classes.name: DefaultMonitoringConfig
classes.description: Immutable class providing access to monitoring-related configuration settings: logger and counter configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultMonitoringConfig from a Config object, scoped at 'monitoring'.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultMonitoringConfig instances based on loggerConfig and counterConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object's class name and its configurations.
